notes.title: SitDW1 -VaP- Remake update 0.05 Demo version.
notes.content:
1. Improved game result screen composition + added rank system
2. Delete [Highest Score] from the battle screen UI
3. Add image to support game selection screen + adjust image size
4. Modification/improvement of player special bullets 1 and 2, added effect when special bullets are activated
5. If FPS exceeds 60, adjust to 60.
6. Modify/improve the player animation to match the changed image (backward, standby, forward, special bullet activation animation and selected sub-weapon change)
7. Modify/improve all boss illustrations and player illustrations that appear
8. Prevent the power level from going down even if you are hit.
9. Fixed an issue where the boss attack would come from outside the screen when restarting from the main screen after depleting all stamina during a boss battle.
10. Fixed the issue where the shot stopped in the middle of the Chapter 2 boss pattern, reduced the shot speed.

notes.title: SitDW1 -VaP- Remake Demo version 0.04 update.
notes.content:
1. Fixed the issue where some sound effects were played even when the sound volume was 0
2. Redesign of items (life, energy, points, special ammo, main weapon conversion)
3. The special Zolgae does not appear right away, but appears after a certain period of time after the location of the special Zolgae appears. + Added a display image when moving after appearing.
4. Add upgrade function to main weapon (display of number consumed, grade, attack power)
5. Simplification of battle screen UI with Tab key and addition of original state conversion function
6. Add player's stamina type to the game selection screen (count type, gauge type)
7. Some improvements to the home screen UI layout + All menus displayed in English only 
8. Added a function where items are recovered from the player if they are within a certain range of the player (recovered regardless of low/high speed mode, range is the same as the image size shown in low speed mode, main weapon conversion items are not recovered)
9. Disable the existing boss fight video and stop moving the field when waiting for the boss fight.
10. Improved presentation when the player is hit 
11. Improved energy use presentation + added functions
12. Improved main character’s basic emotional illustrations
13. Whenever the player is hit, the number of main weapon items acquired is -1 and the number of energy +1 is applied.
14. When defeating a special Zolgae, 1 energy item appears, and a vitality item has a 25% chance to appear (vital force items are limited to field battles and boss battle timers)
15. Improved basic illustrations of bosses that appear in the trial version.
16. Improved field and main screen images (but not all)
17. Make the field move slightly according to the player's up and down movement
18. Added description of functions added to the tutorial.

notes.title: 0.03 update of the remake -VaP- Demo version.
notes.content:
1. The pattern difficulty of some Zolgae and bosses has been adjusted/relaxed.
- The firing speed of bullets fired from the boss emblem in Chapter 2 has been slowed.
- The bullet firing speed of the boss during the 1st phase pattern of the boss in Chapter 3 has been slowed down. (Normal, Hard only)
- The firing speed of bullets fired from various angles during the boss's 3-phase pattern in Chapter 3 has been slowed, and the rotation speed has been made faster.
- Fixed an issue where a Zolgae would disappear without firing a shot even if he appeared in the middle of the field in Chapter 1.
- The Zolgae in the second half of Chapter 2's field was corrected to appear outside the screen instead of appearing without effect on the screen.
- The stamina of the giant Zolgae at the beginning of the field in Chapter 2 has been slightly lowered.
- The stamina of special henchmen has increased slightly.
- Reduced the time it takes to start an attack after a special henchman appears.

2. The design of three types of enemy attack shells has been changed.
- The white area of ​​the existing tan was greatly reduced and the saturation was lowered.
- Applies to all colors of tan with the same design.
- Only the image of the bullet has changed, and the bullet size and hit range are the same.

3. Some malfunctions have been fixed.
- Fixed blue and green weapons not firing in their normal orbit in the tutorial screen.
- If there is a special henchman when the boss is defeated, the boss's explosion effect was changed from occurring on the special henchman to being destroyed as well when the boss is defeated.
- Fixed the issue where the guided missile sub-weapon would fire when pressing the Z key while waiting for the boss battle in Chapter 2.
- Fixed the loading window that appears after defeating a boss being below the boss battle results window.

4. Others
- A sentence has been added to the item information window of the tutorial: [Conversion items only have the function of changing the firing type, and attacking the same color multiple times does not enhance attack power].

[Awaiting fixes/improvements]
The one in the upper right corner of the item description in the tutorial
Field battle background production
boss illustration
Even if the current score is lower than the highest score, the highest score is updated
Simplification of battle screen UI <-> Application of original state conversion system

notes.title: This is the update to version 0.02 of the remake –VaP- Demo version.
notes.content:
[b]1. The player's main weapon conversion system and items have been added.[/b]
- The main weapon types are divided into straight forward (red), wide-area random fire (blue), and Homing fire (green), and when you defeat a special Zolgae, a main weapon conversion item is dropped.
- The main weapon conversion item changes color at certain intervals and is converted into a weapon corresponding to the changed color.
- When the main weapon hits an enemy, a small effect of each color appears briefly and then disappears.
- I don't know if it will continue to the official version, but there are three stationary items placed in the tutorial, and one item slowly moves from the right to the left of the screen when each stage starts.
- The straight-line and wide-area random shooting types have the same firing speed, but the guided shooting type has the characteristic of hitting without any gaps, so the firing speed has been reduced by half.

[b]2. [Guide to player and enemy hits] and [Guide to main weapon conversion item] have been added to the tutorial.[/b]
- The main weapon conversion item information is placed in the tutorial item information window [1st], and the player and enemy hit information is placed in the order just before the UI introduction [6th].
- Only the player's hit range guide has an image, and the enemies' hit range guide only contains sentences.

[b]3. Measures have been taken to ease the frame.[/b]

[b]4. The difficulty of enemy Zolgae attack patterns has been reduced.[/b]
- The Zolgae attack speed at the beginning of Chapter 1 has been greatly reduced.
- The attack speed of other Zolgae has been slightly reduced.

[b]5. Fixed the issue where 0 was displayed in the results window no matter how much bomb was used.
[/b]

notes.title: 0.01 update of the remake -VaP- Demo version.
notes.content:
1. Fixed the issue where the Chapter 2 boss dialogue did not appear after selecting the Shin-Jang-Dae(Second Sub Weapon).

2. Fixed the issue where pressing (Return to main screen) in the menu that appears when Life drops below 0 after Chapter 2 would not return.
(If you press [Return to main screen], the [Game results screen] will appear, then [Developer] will appear, then press the X key to return to the [main screen].)

3. Fixed an issue where FPS would drop below 20 when continuously firing guided missiles when there are no enemies.
(Enemy tracking status is updated every second instead of every frame, and the shooting speed has been increased to reduce screen remaining time.)

3-2. The color of the Homing missile has changed.

4. Some guidance text in the tutorial has been changed.
([Special Gauge] has been changed to [Special Tan Gauge].)
[The green text on the first screen of the tutorial is currently under consideration for improvement.]

5. The pattern difficulty of some henchmen has been lowered.

6. Some FPS-related settings have been adjusted.
